source.description: A reviewed six-panel handmade raster marker contact sheet showing one consistent right-facing cartoon dragon head from pale construction to a bold earthy-marker finish.
source.notes: The current palette lane is earthy/retro: terracotta, moss green, warm cream, and black only—no cyan, raspberry, bright yellow, violet shadow, glossy white highlights, sticker border, or badge frame. The expression uses one narrow almond eye, a heavy slanted brow ridge, a flared nostril, and an asymmetrical open side grin with exactly three fangs. The original v1 sheet is retained privately because its final panel changed the rear horn from cream to terracotta; the approved repair keeps both horns cream.

process_strategy: Lock the head oval, muzzle wedge, neck sweep, and two horn axes first, build the same side-profile silhouette around them, add the non-default expression and exact spike/plate counts, then ink and color only established shapes before the finishing panel.

final_elements.name: head oval, muzzle wedge, neck sweep, and two horn axes
final_elements.description: A right-facing head-and-neck construction with one long muzzle wedge and exactly two swept-back horn guides.

final_elements.name: outer head, muzzle, jaw, neck, and two horns
final_elements.description: One chunky dragon profile with an open lower jaw, curved neck, and exactly two swept horns anchored to the skull.

final_elements.name: narrow eye, slanted brow, flared nostril, side grin, and three fangs
final_elements.description: One narrow almond eye with forward pupil beneath a heavy angled brow, one flared nostril, and an asymmetrical open grin containing exactly three cream fangs.

final_elements.name: pointed ear, three cheek spikes, four neck plates, and inner mouth
final_elements.description: One pointed ear behind the jaw hinge, exactly three cheek spikes, exactly four broad plates down the neck, and a simple tongue-free inner mouth shape.

final_elements.name: thick black outline with terracotta, moss, and cream marker fills
final_elements.description: Handmade black keeper lines, terracotta skin, moss-green neck plates and inner ear, warm-cream horns and fangs, and visible marker streaks with paper gaps.

rejection_checks: The dragon must remain one right-facing head with the same profile, horn angles, neck crop, and scale in every panel.
Exactly two horns, three fangs, three cheek spikes, and four neck plates must persist after their introduction.
Reject a default two-dot-eye and U-smile face; the approved expression requires one narrow eye with a forward pupil, a heavy slanted brow, a flared nostril, and an asymmetrical open side grin.
Every contour, facial feature, spike, plate, mouth shape, and color area must appear before the final panel.
Reject cyan, raspberry, bright yellow, violet shadows, glossy white shine, gradients, sticker borders, badge frames, clean vector icon art, text, labels, wings, flames, full body, or scenery.
